desc: Compute `left[1..N]` and `right[1..N+1]` in O(N) using sets.
Initialize a segment tree supporting point set, range add, and range max query over indices 1..N-1.
Iterate `j` from 2 to N-1: update range with previous occurrence, query max, update answer.
Implement and test on the two sample inputs to verify correctness.
